name: QA | Error Handler

parameters.content:
## QA | Error Handler (WF4)
Set as the **Error workflow** of WF1–WF3 (Workflow settings → Error workflow). Fires on production executions only.
Posts workflow name, failing node, execution ID (+ link) and the error message to Slack — including strict-JSON schema failures thrown by the validator Code nodes.

description: Sprint QA Automation WF4: Error Trigger → Slack alert with workflow name, failing node, execution ID and error message. Error workflow for WF1–WF3.
